title: Separate the product test harness from implementation features
description: The analysis maps QUAL-002 to a dedicated automated test runner story. Keeping that scope separate gives test coverage and stubbed fetch behavior a clear owner.

options.label: Tests included in each implementation story

title: Acceptance criterion rates-by-date-route proves nothing
description:
FEATURE-API-Rates.md [rates-by-date-route]: accepts [200, 404]: 404 means the endpoint is absent, so this passes against an application that implements nothing. Assert 404 alone for a negative probe, or assert the status the implementation answers with. (assert response.status_code in (200, 404))

A criterion states one expectation. Pin the status the implementation answers with — a stub that answers is a real contract and a real test — or assert the not-found status alone as a deliberate negative probe. A criterion that needs a row to exist creates it through the public interface first rather than admitting the status that says it never existed.
